title: rosa tomentella var. halacsyi
intro: Rosa tomentella var. halacsyi, commonly known as Hungarian rose, is a plant species in the family Rosaceae, characterized by its fragrant flowers and woody stems. The health benefits of Rosa tomentella var. halacsyi include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which can help in reducing stress and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its ability to act as an antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant, making it useful in wound healing and skin care. The bioactive constituents of Rosa tomentella var. halacsyi include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and volatile oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
